captions.detailed: A floor-standing task lamp featuring a wide, flat circular base in matte black and a long vertical silver-grey pole. At the top of the vertical pole, a dark grey swivel joint connects to a horizontal extension arm. At the tip of this arm, a cylindrical beige lamp shade is attached via a tilting hinge mechanism, allowing the light direction to be adjusted.
captions.instruction: Generate a floor-standing task lamp with a circular black base, a tall vertical pole, a rotating joint at the top of the pole, a horizontal arm, and a beige cylindrical lamp shade that can tilt at the end of the arm.
captions.factory: Construct a base using a wide, thin cylinder, and a vertical column using a tall, thin cylinder. Create a swivel joint at the top of the column with a small vertical cylinder and a collar. Build the horizontal arm as a cylinder extending outward from a hinge joint. Model the lamp shade by subtracting an inner cylinder from an outer cylinder to create a hollow shell, then attach it to the arm with a horizontal revolute joint.
